about.text: Acid casein reacted with calcium hydroxide and dried: a protein powder that disperses in water to a white, milky liquid, used in drinks, nutrition bars, creamers and toppings.

facts.v: Ca(OH)₂ reacts more slowly with the curd than NaOH
Less soluble than sodium caseinate, poorer functional properties; solutions can destabilise on heating, especially below pH 6
